"Over here," Fanatic called out.  Ra could see she had found it, and none to soon, the clicking sound was building, there would be another fireball coming soon.  "You need to pull down the third lever," Ra shouted back to her, as the others worked their way towards them.  With a hiss the clicking died down and a panel opened.

With a last barrage of cover fire from Expatriette's Assault Rifle the heroes ducked through the opening and into a new corridor as the panel closed behind them.

They may have escaped the fire chamber, but now the pale green light that surrounded them had grown stronger, and heavier.  Like they were walking through a fog that had no substance to it.

To say it was disconcerting would be an understatement, and you could almost hear a scream. . . no, not hear, you could almost feel it on your skin.

"Keep moving," Ra told the others, "they will catch up soon."

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Expatriette wasn't thinking, she had shut that part of her off.  They had come into a large round room, the green haze was incredibly strong now.  Expatriette crouched lower and instinctively followed her training.  She moved to flank the citizens, laying down fire with her assault rifle.

As long as she could hold them there  the Target wouldn't be able to really let loose without killing her own followers.

"This is not good," John said to no one in particular, "the Lines, they are all converging. . ." he did not get to finish his sentence.

TRESPASSERS UPON THIS SACRED GROUND, PREPARE YOURSELVES FOR JUDGEMENT

Taking this opportunity to remind everyone of the special rules for this fight.  Any damage dealt by Anubis or his Rod (including if Rod is in the Environment play area when Shamise deals damage) ignores reduction and immunity, it can be redirected but that is it. (sadly for our heroes that means Anubis cannot be stopped by chastise or Zealous offense, and Flak Jacket will not react at all to his damage).  Anubis does his normal effect on his card, but also deals each non-environment target 1 infernal damage anytime an environment target is destroyed.

Anubis cannot be destroyed by any card effect that targets an environment card, for thepurposes of this fight he can be destroyed by HP=0, Dawns Aurora and End of Days.  

He's a god, and we are on his turf.

THE TOMB OF ANUBIS

In Play:  Cast into the Underworld

Trash:  The Challege of Fire

-------------------------

Start of Turn:  less than 5 environment targets in play(0), Cast into the Underworld is not destroyed.

Play a Card:  Judgement of Anubis  Anubis enters play [20] takes 2 from HtR [18]

End of Turn:  Anubis deals 3 infernal damage to every target (4 to Ra).  When the first citizen is destroyed Anubis will damage any hero but Absolute Zero for 3 Infernal (all in how you order the damage).  Then Judgement of Anubis will be destroyed and Anubis will respond by dealing all non-environment targets 2 damage (3 for Ra).

-------------------------

In Play:  Cast into the Underworld, Anubis [15]

Trash:  The Challenge of Fire

 

Effects:

Start:  If there are 5 or more environment cards in play destroy Cast into the Underworld.

Static:  Increase damage dealt by environment targets by 1.

           Anubis is immune to damage from environment cards.

Misc:  The first time a Non-Environment card is destroyed each turn Anubis deals the Non-Environment target with the 2nd highest HP 2 infernal damage.

Scenario rules:  Whenever an Environment card is destroyed Anubis deals each non-Environment target 1 infernal damage.

              Damage dealt by Anubis or his staff (including Shamise if Rod of Anubis is in the Environment play area) ignores immunity and reduction.
